messages.en: What are you doing?
I'm on vacation right now.
I went with my older female cousin, my younger sibling, and my older brother.
We went to Gangneung yesterday.
I paid for most of it.
Flex!!!!!
We looked at the sea and ate tons of sashimi.
Laser Attack?
We played something like that.

messages.ko: 총 들고 진짜 서로 막 숨었다 쏘고
messages.en: We were carrying laser guns, hiding from each other, and shooting.
It was like real-life PUBG.
My brother came in first, and my younger sibling came in second.
I got third... and my cousin came in last.
Can you believe it!!!
But it was only two games in 30 minutes.
It seriously counts as a workout.
By the time we came out, sweat was literally dripping off me.
My cousin also brought her digital camera and took a bunch of pictures.
I'll upload them later.
Hyerin called me.
She said she misses me so much.
Oh right, 'Best Friend Introduction' came out, didn't it?
I've been dying to talk about the bungee jump.
ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ
Right before we were about to jump,
the wind got super strong and everything was shaking.
Then the moment we jumped, it started raining.
How did you even hold onto the camera? ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 아니 딱 뛰는데 카메라가 내눈앞에 날아가려 하능고
messages.en: Right as I jumped, the camera almost flew right into my face.
I caught it immediately.
And bungee jumping...

messages.ko: 롤러코스터처럼 한번 훅 떨어지고 마는게 아니라
messages.en: It's not like a roller coaster where you just drop once.

messages.ko: 계속 무중력에 있는 느낌이라 뛰고 나서도 계속 무섭더라
messages.en: It feels like you're stuck in zero gravity the whole time, so even after I finished jumping, I was still terrified.
You looked so cool jumping on the first try.
That was editing....
I hesitated for five whole minutes.
I even tried to run away, but they caught me.
More than the jump itself,
I was scared the bungee cord might snap.
Kim Chaewon bounced pretty steadily,
when she bounced.
But I was spinning around and folding up all over the place.
Hyerin...
said she loves me.
I'm going crazy.
When is she going to hang up?

messages.ko: ㅋㅋ 하연이 요즘 인기가 넘 좋은데 ㅋㅋ
messages.en: ㅋㅋ Hayeon is so popular these days ㅋㅋ
This is troublesome~~~
"Kawaii dake... something... desu ka?"
Wasn't it 'dame desu ka'...?
Ah, that's right.
It's 'Kawaii dake ja dame desu ka.'
Ahhh, right!
Unnie, have you seen the new Minions movie?
It's out?????
It's about to be released.
I seriously can't wait. I'm going to watch it as soon as it comes out.
Minions are so cute.

messages.ko: 순진하고 귀여운 모습을 하고 지들 보스 막 죽이고
messages.en: They're innocent and adorable, yet they end up killing their own boss.
They keep saying 'banana.' They're just too cute.
Bob is the cutest. He's my favorite.
We'll become Minions too.
So I'm Gru then?
Just come dressed up..?
That might be a bit much...
Paint yourself yellow and wear goggles?
Could you survive making Minion noises all day?
I actually studied the Minion language before.

messages.ko: 하라는 영어공부는 안하고 하이뽀! 빠나나이런것만 외움
messages.en: Instead of studying English, I only memorized things like 'Haippo!' and 'Banana!'
Is the dress code for this concert Minions?
Even when we decide things like that,
nobody actually does it.
I get all excited,
then everyone shows up dressed normally. There's never a Minion anywhere!!
I'm not asking for the clothes.
I want full face paint too!!
Just imagine how cute that would be.
Aww.
People on public transportation would be shocked...
No! 'Bee-ba-bee-bo? Haippo!'
So cute.
My own Minion, Y/n.

messages.ko: 난 그 머리 위로 쫙 쫌면 애기처럼 하고갈래ㅎㅎ
messages.en: I'll style my hair sticking straight up like a little kid. ㅎㅎ
Agnes?
You mean the one who looks like me?
ㅎ
The cutest one is actually Sha'an.
Xie xie.
Who's Sha'an?
That's my Chinese name.
Ding Xiayan.
Wasn't it Haochi?
How can a person's name be 'delicious'...?
That's my favorite Chinese word.
Haochi!!!!
Oh right, I was at my parents' house today.
For breakfast I made rosé tteokbokki, stir-fried enoki mushrooms with kimchi, and even dessert.
Hayeon's Kitchen was open.
I'm actually good at cooking...
I've been trying to clear up that misunderstanding for years.
As long as there are ingredients in the fridge,
I can make pretty much anything.
My cooking style is kind of like
Chef Yoon Nam-no.
Busy, fast, constantly eating while cooking...
That kind of vibe.
I hope one day I'll get to cook something for Y/n
I hope that day comes.
Don't tell me to do it at a concert.
I'd have to be like an army cook,
holding a giant ladle.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
If you could only cook me one dish, what would you make?
Spicy stir-fried pork.
I'll make it properly.
Would your spicy pork be the dry cafeteria style?
Or the juicy kind with lots of sauce?
Definitely the juicy, saucy kind with plenty of oil.
That's the only way spicy stir-fried pork tastes good.
Now I suddenly want some.
During my vacation, I ate as much raw shrimp as I wanted.
I think I emptied an entire shrimp farm.
Sorry, shrimp...
Still... I heard crustaceans don't feel as much pain...
...I think.
.......Let's stop talking about it. I feel too bad.
Yeah... I'm crying through my mouth.
Aren't you supposed to be dieting???
You've been saying that for 365 days.
Has it already been that long?
I stopped exercising because I wanted to lose muscle.
But I can really feel my athletic ability getting worse.
I need to start exercising again.

messages.ko: 난 운동하면 바로 근육 붙는 스타일이라
messages.en: I'm the type of person who builds muscle really easily.
I'd end up looking like a female bodybuilder.
Wouldn't your shoulders get even broader?
Exactly.
That's why I intentionally lost muscle.
But I think my stamina is worse than Yooyeon unnie's now.
I'll start working out again.
If I raced Yooyeon, I'd lose...
I think I need to eat.
I'm getting cranky now.
Hurry and feed me!!!!!
Give me food!!!!!
Want me to recommend something to eat?
Do it.
Okay, spicy stir-fried pork it is.
Doesn't my love fill your stomach?
My heart is always full~~
But my stomach... that's a different story.
There are just too many delicious foods in this world.
It's so frustrating. ㅠㅠ
I'll make sure to eat lots!
헤헤헤.
Go eat something delicious too,Y/n
and send me lots of cute thoughts~ 😘
Haranghae. 😍
